descriptions.d27h_jetpack_velocity_step_800aabbc: Jetpack velocity step: stores the velocity at +100, runs 0x800abd30, builds the up force from the setting at +192 and the gravity vector at 0x8045e788, rotates it through two axis matrices when thrusting or when the input is non-zero, scales the force from the time left against the fuel limit (over the ceiling it uses the setting at +204, otherwise a sine fade with 0x800ac03c or 0x800abfe0 and the boost at +160), applies the drag settings at +228 or +232 to x and z, adds the force and returns the velocity.
